import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, time
import matplotlib; import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, dendrogram
from scipy.spatial.distance import squareform
h={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}

H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3

K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=B62.split("\n"); aas=ls[0].split(); MAT=np.zeros((24,24),dtype=np.int32)-4
code={c:i for i,c in enumerate("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYXBZU")}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for b,v in zip(aas,p[1:]): MAT[code[p[0]],code[b]]=int(v)
enc=lambda s: np.array([code.get(c,20) for c in s],dtype=np.int32)
GO,GE=11,1
def nwid(a,b):
    la,lb=len(a),len(b); sub=MAT[a][:,b]; NEG=-10**8
    Hprev=np.empty(lb+1,dtype=np.int64); Hprev[0]=0; Hprev[1:]=-GO-GE*np.arange(lb)
    Dprev=np.full(lb+1,NEG,dtype=np.int64); ptr=np.zeros((la+1,lb+1),dtype=np.int8); ptr[0,1:]=1
    j_ar=np.arange(lb+1)
    for i in range(1,la+1):
        H=np.empty(lb+1,dtype=np.int64); Dcur=np.empty(lb+1,dtype=np.int64); Dcur[0]=NEG
        diag=Hprev[:-1]+sub[i-1]; Dcur[1:]=np.maximum(Hprev[1:]-GO,Dprev[1:]-GE)
        best=np.maximum(diag,Dcur[1:])
        tmp=np.empty(lb+1,dtype=np.int64); tmp[0]=-GO-GE*(i-1); tmp[1:]=best
        I=np.maximum.accumulate(tmp-GO+GE*(j_ar+1))-GE*j_ar
        H[0]=tmp[0]; H[1:]=np.maximum(best,I[1:])
        p=np.zeros(lb+1,dtype=np.int8); p[0]=2
        p[1:]=np.where(H[1:]==diag,0,np.where(H[1:]==Dcur[1:],2,1)); ptr[i]=p
        Hprev,Dprev=H,Dcur
    i,j=la,lb; ident=0
    while i>0 or j>0:
        d=ptr[i,j]
        if i>0 and j>0 and d==0:
            ident+= (a[i-1]==b[j-1]); i-=1;j-=1
        elif d==1 and j>0: j-=1
        elif i>0: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return 100.0*ident/min(la,lb)

fa=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
   params={"query":'(family:"GDSL lipolytic enzyme family") AND (taxonomy_id:3702) AND (reviewed:true)',"format":"fasta"},
   headers=h,timeout=180).text
S={}
for blk in fa.split(">")[1:]:
    L=blk.split("\n"); S[L[0].split("|")[1]]=("".join(L[1:])).strip()
nm=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
   params={"query":'(family:"GDSL lipolytic enzyme family") AND (taxonomy_id:3702) AND (reviewed:true)',
           "fields":"accession,gene_names","format":"tsv"},headers=h,timeout=180).text
GN={l.split("\t")[0]: (l.split("\t")[1].split()[0] if len(l.split("\t"))>1 and l.split("\t")[1] else l.split("\t")[0]) for l in nm.strip().split("\n")[1:]}

CHAR={"Q7XA74":"MVP1/GOLD36","Q9FLN0":"GLIP1","Q9SYF0":"GLIP2","Q9LJG3":"ESM1","Q9FXE5":"FXG1",
 "Q9M8Y5":"LTL1","Q9C7N5":"At1g29660","Q0WUV7":"EXL4","Q9LIN2":"At3g26430","Q8W4H8":"GLL23","Q93X94":"EXL6",
 "Q9FXJ2":"At1g28580","Q9SZW7":"At4g30140(CDEF1-like)","Q9LU14":"APG"}
q="Q9FFN0"; qe=enc(S[q])
ident_q={a: nwid(qe,enc(s)) for a,s in S.items()}
top=sorted(ident_q,key=ident_q.get,reverse=True)[:30]
sel=sorted(set(top)|set(CHAR)|{q})
print("tree taxa:",len(sel))
E={a:enc(S[a]) for a in sel}
t0=time.time(); n=len(sel); Dm=np.zeros((n,n))
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        v=nwid(E[sel[i]],E[sel[j]]); Dm[i,j]=Dm[j,i]=100-v
print("all-vs-all %.1fs"%(time.time()-t0))
labels=[]
for a in sel:
    lab=CHAR.get(a, GN.get(a,a))
    tag=" *" if a in CHAR else ""
    labels.append(("%s (%s) %.0f%%"%(lab,a,ident_q[a]))+tag)
Z=linkage(squareform(Dm,checks=False),method="average")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,12))
dn=dendrogram(Z,labels=labels,orientation="left",ax=ax,color_threshold=62)
ax.set_xlabel("distance (100 - % identity, global Needleman-Wunsch BLOSUM62)")
ax.set_title("Arabidopsis GDSL esterase/lipase family: UPGMA clustering of pairwise identity\n"
             "AT5G03810 (Q9FFN0) and its nearest relatives; * = entry with a UniProt FUNCTION annotation")
for t in ax.get_ymajorticklabels():
    if "Q9FFN0" in t.get_text(): t.set_color("crimson"); t.set_fontweight("bold")
    elif any(x in t.get_text() for x in ["Q9LZC5","Q9FFC6","Q0WPI9","Q9LU14"]): t.set_color("darkorange")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
pd.DataFrame(Dm,index=sel,columns=sel).to_csv("GELP_distance_matrix.csv")
